name: Sireth, Spear of the Sky

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +7 Enhancement Bonus : +7 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Supreme Good
effects.tooltip: Supreme Good : This weapon is infused with the supreme Power of Good. It does an additional 3 to 18 damage to non-good targets and can only be wielded by Good-aligned characters.

effects.name: Lightning Strike
effects.tooltip: Lightning Strike : This weapon stores the power of a volatile thunderstorm deep within. Occasionally, this dynamic power comes to the surface, devastating enemies with a massive lightning strike.

effects.name: Cloudburst
effects.tooltip: Cloudburst : On Vorpal , this weapon triggers a Cloudburst, striking its target with lightning and dealing sonic damage to surrounding enemies through a powerful thunderclap.

effects.name: Freedom of Movement
effects.tooltip: Freedom of Movement : This item grants its wearer the ability to move and attack normally while under the influence of magic that impedes movement, such as paralysis, solid fog, slow and web.

effects.name: Feather Falling
effects.tooltip: Feather Falling : This item is engraved with feathers and bestows a powerful magical effect. Whenever the wearer begins to fall from any height, this effect slows the descent dramatically, causing the wearer to fall like a feather.

customisation_hints.name: Attuned to Heroism
children: Attuned by Heroism: Tier 1 Adds Planar Conflux
Attuned by Heroism: Tier 2 +7 Enhancement Bonus → +8 Enhancement Bonus
Attuned by Heroism: Tier 3 Adds +0.5 weapon dice multiplier
Attuned by Heroism: Tier 4 Adds Red Augment Slot

flavor_text: Said to have been wielded by an astral deva, this spear is capable of tearing open the vault of heaven to bring the wrath of the skies down upon your enemies.
tips: Although this is a quarterstaff, it does Slash and Pierce damage, not Bludgeon. This does not change the Improved Critical feat that you need for this weapon - Improved Critical: Bludgeoning Note that Pulverizor does not currently work with Sireth. May not be WAI.

source.raw: Caught in the Web , End Chest
